extraction_caveats:
1. This is a battery-electric vehicle (EM57 motor); there is no engine oil, spark plugs, fuel filter, or transmission fluid in the conventional sense.
2. The maintenance schedule is presented as discrete mileage columns (7,500 / 15,000 / 22,500 … / 120,000 miles). Recurring items have been collapsed into repeat intervals where the pattern is consistent across all columns.
3. Intelligent Key battery: the schedule shows an *inspect* at 22,500 mi/18 mo and *replace* at 45,000 mi/36 mo, then replace again at 90,000/72 mo and 112,500/90 mo — all month-based only per the footnote. The replace cadence is irregular. The single earlier inspect is noted separately.
4. Coolant first replacement is at 125,000 miles or 15 years; subsequent replacements every 75,000 miles or 5 years. The first_at_miles/first_at_months fields capture the initial service; the interval_miles/interval_months fields capture the subsequent repeat interval.
5. Brake fluid severe-use replacement recurs every 15,000 miles/12 months; standard-schedule replacement recurs every 30,000 miles/24 months — both patterns confirmed across all schedule columns.
6. Charging port sealing cap inspection appears only at 30k, 60k, 90k, and 120k mile intervals (every 30,000 miles/24 months) in the standard schedule.
7. Items marked with '*' in the manual (EV System Charging Port, Charging Port Sealing Cap, Windshield-washer fluid) are described as 'recommended by NISSAN for reliable vehicle operation' and not required to maintain warranty.
8. The 37,500-mile/30-month and 67,500-mile/54-month and 97,500-mile/78-month standard schedule entries state 'Not applicable. Proceed to next interval.' — no unique standard items at those milestones beyond the universal 7,500-mile items.
9. Reduction gear oil is inspected (visually, for leakage) on the standard schedule; no replacement interval for reduction gear fluid is specified in the maintenance schedule pages — only a fluid specification is given.
10. Page 440 content (ProPILOT/Steering Assist) is not relevant to maintenance schedules and was not used.
11. Intelligent Key battery replace at 67,500/54 mo is listed on page 570, but this does not fit a regular cadence with the other replacements at 45k/36mo, 90k/72mo, 112.5k/90mo. The pattern is irregular.
12. The severe schedule at 22,500 miles (page 567) does NOT list brake fluid replacement or any severe-specific essential items — only inspections. The first severe brake fluid replace appears at 15,000 miles (page 567).
